Due to a permanent communication blackout zone, a direct flight corridor between Station Alpha and Station Beta cannot be utilized. Furthermore, operational protocols mandate that exactly one of the following two critical flight paths must be incorporated into the inspection circuit: the corridor between Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the corridor between Station Gamma and Station Delta.

The objective is to determine the most fuel-efficient closed-loop flight plan that visits every monitoring station exactly once before returning to the point of origin.
